component.name: AmpGhost
component.summary: Control your BOSS Katana MK II amp

description.p: AmpGhost is a desktop editor for the BOSS Katana MK II guitar amplifier. It connects to the amp over USB MIDI and lets you shape the sound of the current patch from your computer.

ul.li: See the whole signal chain and switch blocks on and off
Edit amp, booster, effects, delay, reverb and noise gate parameters live
Keep a library of local presets and apply them to the amp
Back up the amp to a BOSS TONE STUDIO file and import or export presets in the .tsl format

description.p: AmpGhost only writes to the temporary patch of the amp. It never overwrites stored channels or system settings, and it backs up the temporary patch before every change. The Katana 50 MK II is supported. Other models are detected but stay read only.
BOSS and KATANA are trademarks of Roland Corporation. AmpGhost is not affiliated with or endorsed by Roland Corporation.

ul.li: Follows knob changes made on the amp
Turns the amp's editor mode off again when the app closes
Shows the build commit in the About dialog
Shows the full cause of an error
Uses its own icons on the status pages and the ghost in the symbolic app icon
Connects live to a Katana 50 MK II over USB and reconnects when the amp comes back
Edits the blocks of the signal chain in the temporary patch
Switches between the Panel, A1, A2, B1 and B2 channels
Keeps local presets on your computer
Imports and exports BOSS TONE STUDIO .tsl livesets
Backs up the temporary patch automatically before a whole patch replaces it
